execution.implementation: deterministic heavy-atom van der Waals overlap diagnostic with explicit covalent graph exclusions

observations: The method admits 327 heavy atoms and tests 51,964 nonbonded pairs after graph exclusions.
No tested pair exceeds 0.4 Å overlap under the recorded van der Waals radii.
The calculation covers the retained asymmetric-unit coordinates and does not generate symmetry mates.
interpretation: The zero count is conditional on the deposited coordinates and explicit method and is not a general structure-validation score.
limitations: Hydrogens are absent, so this is not an all-atom clashscore.
Bonding is inferred with simple coordinate rules.
Symmetry contacts, uncertainty, and dynamics are excluded.

provenance.note: The local script applies recorded radii, bond inference, graph exclusions, and overlap threshold to the public coordinate snapshot; the separate Rosalind observation records launcher availability without a scientific job.

reproduction: Run scripts/analyze.py with Python 3.14 or a compatible standard-library Python.
Confirm 327 admitted atoms, 51,964 tested pairs, and zero overlaps above 0.4 Å.
Match the radii, covalent exclusions, alternate-location policy, model, and symmetry scope before comparing another tool.
